svg.title: Technical skills - 47 nodes, 7 systems
svg.desc: Skills HUD. Three tilted elliptical orbits: inner orbit, daily drivers (Python, TypeScript, Rust, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, FastAPI, Tauri); middle orbit, AI and data (RAG, Ollama, OpenCV, FAISS, HuggingFace, SQLite, Postgres); outer orbit, toolbox (Git, GitHub, AWS, Vercel, Supabase, MongoDB, Blender, Gemini). Below, all 47 nodes grouped into 7 systems: LANGUAGES: Python, TypeScript, Rust, JavaScript, C++, C#, C, Kotlin; FRONTEND: React, Tailwind, HTML, CSS, Angular, Bootstrap, React Native, Streamlit; BACKEND: Node.js, FastAPI, Express, Django; DESKTOP: Tauri, Electron, Tkinter; AI / MACHINE LEARNING: RAG, Agents, OpenCV, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, FAISS, HuggingFace, ChromaDB, MediaPipe, Ollama, Gemini; DATABASES & CLOUD: SQL, SQLite, Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, AWS; TOOLS & DEPLOYMENT: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, Blender.
